fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of a master's in computer science at Newcastle? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 dates.

The Computer Science MSc is a **12-month**, full-time course taught on campus, starting September 2027. It is a conversion course: it teaches computing to graduates from other subjects. The School of Computing is in the £58 million Urban Sciences Building on the Newcastle Helix site.

**The most important fact for you:** your degree must not be in a subject related to computer science. Computing graduates are asked to apply for the Advanced Computer Science MSc instead.

The first nine months are taught modules worth **120 credits**, examined by written papers. They include Programming and Data Structures, Software Engineering and Team Project, Database Systems, Web Technologies, Cybersecurity, Computer Networks, Human Computer Interaction, and AI Fundamentals and Responsible Innovation. The final three months are a **60-credit** dissertation project.

For the wider university, see our [Newcastle University page](/study-abroad/universities/newcastle-university).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a 2:2 honours degree, or equivalent, in any subject except those related to computer science. A 2:2 is a UK honours grade, one step below a 2:1. Newcastle considers lower or non-standard qualifications if you have relevant experience.

**Indian marks.** With India selected, Newcastle's entry table lists a 2:2 as **58%** or a CGPA of 5.8/10 (Section 1), **60%** or 6.0/10 (Section 2) and **63%** or 6.3/10 (Section 3). The page does not say which universities fall in each section, so ask admissions which applies to yours.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. For direct entry you need **IELTS 6.5** overall with at least **5.5** in all sub-skills. With lower scores you may be offered a pre-sessional English course.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Newcastle's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£33,400** per year for 2027 entry. The course lasts 12 months.

Newcastle is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | £33,400 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£45,949** |

The sum is £33,400 + £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £45,949. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** Indian applicants who need a visa pay a deposit of **£3,000**, or send an official letter of sponsorship, by **27 August 2027**. If the course needs ATAS, the date is **13 August 2027**. The deposit is paid after an offer, is non-refundable and comes off your tuition when you register.

**Application fee.** No fee is listed on the course page.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

- **Newcastle University India Future Leaders Scholarship:** **£10,000** off tuition. Eligible candidates get it automatically with their course application. You must accept your offer and pay the deposit in full by **2 August 2027**, which is earlier than the normal deposit date. This course is not on the scholarship's non-eligible list. Fully sponsored students do not qualify.
- **Vice-Chancellor's Excellence Scholarship:** up to **50%** off tuition. Apply in the Apply to Newcastle Portal, in the scholarship section, by **8 June 2027**. You cannot hold this together with the India Future Leaders Scholarship: if you win both, you keep the higher award.
- The course page also says you may be eligible for a scholarship worth **25%** off the international fee.

See the [global scholarships page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/study/global-scholarships/).

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Deadline | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | All applicants | No closing date | Apply Online (Newcastle application portal) |
| September 2027 | Indian applicants: deposit or sponsor letter | 27 August 2027 | Applicant portal |
| September 2027 | India Future Leaders: offer accepted and deposit paid | 2 August 2027 | Applicant portal |

There is no application closing date. Newcastle suggests international students apply at least two months before the course starts. To get the India scholarship, you need to be ready by 2 August 2027.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** Make sure your degree is not in a computer science subject.
2. **Apply online.** Use Apply Online on the [course page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5055f/). The portal tells you which documents to upload, and you can save and return.
3. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay **£3,000** by 2 August 2027 to keep the India Future Leaders Scholarship.
4. **Apply for the Excellence Scholarship** by 8 June 2027 if you want to be considered.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- your degree is in engineering (other than computer science), science, commerce or arts, and you want a software career
- you have about 58% to 63% from your Indian university
- you want the automatic **£10,000** India Future Leaders Scholarship

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in computer science or IT, because the course sends you to Advanced Computer Science
- you need a January start, because the course starts in September only

faq_json.q: Can I do the Newcastle MSc Computer Science with a BTech in computer science?
faq_json.a: No. Graduates of computer science subjects are asked to apply for the Advanced Computer Science MSc instead.

faq_json.q: How much does it cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £33,400 for 2027 entry. Adding visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge gives £45,949 for the year.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: For a 2:2, Newcastle lists 58%, 60% or 63% (or CGPA 5.8, 6.0 or 6.3 out of 10), depending on the section your university is in.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Yes. The India Future Leaders Scholarship gives £10,000 automatically if you accept your offer and pay the deposit by 2 August 2027.
No. There is no closing date, but Newcastle suggests applying at least two months before the September start.
